From a question to a working system

A sample note about conversational AI, with room for words, figures, and a closer look at the work.

Sep 20, 2026Sample note

This is a sample note for exploring the reading experience. The project figures below come from the work already on this site; the surrounding text is illustrative.

Start with a question

When should an AI system join a conversation? A useful answer has to consider both the information it brings and the attention it asks for.

The InsightToast project explores this through source-grounded text and glanceable visualizations. Its overview brings the retrieval, presentation, and control pieces into one picture.

Leave room to look closer

A figure can give a quick impression in the flow of an article. Opening it at a larger size makes the details easier to inspect. Select any image in this note, then use the arrows or swipe to move through all three.

The surrounding explanation and the figure should help a reader answer the same question.

For a longer project note, that might mean including:

  • The question or situation that motivated the work.
  • A figure that makes the system concrete.
  • Links to the paper, code, or demonstration.

The AInsight project offers another view of conversational AI. Its figure appears in the gallery below.

A small place to keep writing

Notes can be short observations or longer articles. This example also includes a code block to inspect how technical details fit the page:

note = {
    "question": "What would help?",
    "prototype": "Make the idea tangible.",
    "reflection": "What did we learn?",
}

This sample can be edited, replaced, or hidden before launch by setting draft: true in its Markdown file.
